facts.fact: Oubangui Medias reports that after a pilot in Bangui and corridor towns, the EU-funded civil registry modernisation project (digitisation and digital tools, run by CIVIPOL for the ministry) is extending significantly to new communes.
facts.system: Appui a la Modernisation, a la Securisation et a l'Accessibilite du Systeme d'Etat Civil en RCA (MODERO)
